start: Member: New phone, Settings, Backup and restore, 'Bring back a Google Drive backup' card, terms ticked, no workout open, online

steps.action: Tap 'Find my Drive backup' and pick the Google account in Google's sign-in
user_sees: 'Working…' on the button
The card line changes to 'Looking in the Google Drive of <email>. Bring your old backup to this phone.'
must_not: Any network call before the tap
A second sign-in asked for the same account

steps.action: Read the question 'Bring back your Drive backup?' and tap 'Bring it back'
user_sees: The body 'This replaces what’s on this phone with your backup' with what is in it, and how many workouts on this phone it removes
must_not: The question hiding that workouts on this phone go
The restore starting before the tap

steps.action: Wait for it to finish
user_sees: 'Your workouts are back on this phone. To keep them safe from now on, sign in on the “Backup and restore” page.'
Home and chat screens show the restored workouts
must_not: Screens still showing the old data
A backup made to Drive again (Drive backup is no longer offered)

start: Member: Drive already linked to the wrong Google account

steps.action: Tap 'Find my Drive backup'
user_sees: 'There’s no MettleUp backup in this Google account. Try “Unlink Google Drive”, then another account.'
must_not: A restore from an empty folder
Phone data changed

steps.action: Tap 'Unlink Google Drive', tick the terms box, tap 'Find my Drive backup' and pick the other account
user_sees: The card back to 'Backed up to Google Drive with an older version of MettleUp?…'
Then the 'Bring back your Drive backup?' question
must_not: Unlink tappable while 'Working…' runs
The old account still used after unlinking

start: Member: Settings, the Drive card, a workout in progress, terms not ticked

steps.action: Tap 'Find my Drive backup' with a workout open
user_sees: Red line 'Finish your workout first: finish or discard the workout in progress, then restore.'
must_not: Google sign-in opening
The open workout's exercises replaced

steps.action: Finish the workout, tap again without ticking the 18+ and terms box
user_sees: A buzz and the box's own red words under the button
must_not: Google's sign-in opening before the box is ticked

steps.action: Tick the box, go offline and tap again
user_sees: Red 'Could not bring back your backup. Nothing was changed. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: Partial data on the phone
The button stuck on 'Working…'

start: Member: Right after a Drive restore on this phone

steps.action: Tap 'Undo the last restore'
user_sees: The question 'Undo the restore?' saying how many newer workouts go
Button 'Undo restore'
must_not: Undo starting without the question

steps.action: Tap 'Undo restore'
user_sees: 'Done. This phone is back to how it was before the restore.'
must_not: Workouts from before the restore missing
'Undo the last restore' still shown with nothing left to undo

steps.action: Bring back the same backup again
user_sees: 'That backup was already brought back.' or the question again
must_not: The same workouts added twice

start: Member: Settings, the Drive card, not linked

steps.action: Link a Google account and bring back the backup
user_sees: Only the backup is read from Drive
must_not: Anything written to Drive
The Google email sent to the gym
Another person's MettleUp backup shown
